title: ze_Devil_May_Cry
summary:
Attention!Map need to run on ZombieEscape server to play properly. It won't work if you run the map under local without CS2FIX plugins. ze_Devil_May_Cry Map by @Seth Port and fully remake from CSGO with total less a month i guess ·Map design is based on the game Devil May Cry 5,You will play as special soldier,working with devil hunters to save Red Grave City from Qliphoth invasion. Map current includes: ·Total 5 stages -Every stages contain unique boss fight,refence from the original game. ·Character -20+ Different Character and items from DMC5,some of character and items have counter effect on each other,check information at dante's office to learn more. ·Red Soulstone -Shooting zombies/Infect humans to gain Red Soulstone with chances,or gain from finish a stages,then you can spend it to purchase Perks for yourself at dante's office. But Perks will disable for you if you are Character,also Perks will be clear after a stage passed. (might add more Perks in future i guess.) ·Blue Soulstone -There will be 4 Blue Soulstone randomly spawn in the map every stage,each Soulstone increase all human max health,collect them to make sure your team could survive from boss fight. I been plan to work on npc and side quests etc but im kinda lazy to design them so nope. some remaining content like cutsences will finish in later update. Even this map really did not meet my expectations,but i feel satisfied to make one of my favorite game into a ZE map,hope you enjoy. Also huge thanks to everyone who support me on this map,there will be some reward for my supporters,and it does not affect the map playthough. uh not gonna talk about this in here or someone gonna "hate" me for this lmaooooolol Do not use any content that i port from Devil May Cry 5 to your maps,really annoying to port them from dmc5. Map assets from CAPCOM,Devil May Cry 5 Servers required old push enable .
